prompt:
Create one production game icon sprite sheet for an original fantasy MOBA. Exact square 4 columns x 4 rows = 16 square icons, equal cell dimensions, cells flush edge-to-edge, each fills its own square, no gutters, no borders, no labels, no letters, no numerals, no UI mockup. Crisp painterly realism like hand painted classic PC fantasy ability icons: deep dark background, dimensional materials, powerful close-up silhouette, rich restrained colors, bright focal action, clean at 44 pixels. Each subject occupies 75-85% of its cell; critical parts stay within safe 8% margins. Entirely original artwork. Consistent style and lighting. Do not copy existing game icons. Precise row-major contents:
ROW 1 archery hero, green/bronze with crimson ultimate:
1. A bow loosing a dense fan of many steel arrows, five layered waves, arrows flying toward lower right; represents channelled 30-arrow barrage.
2. One enormous silver arrow ripping forward through green wind, a small enemy silhouette thrown sideways and splintered tree; arrow knocks targets aside.
3. Extreme close-up of a taut bow and clean arrowhead with precise bright physical-impact burst; agility-powered archery critical bonus, no eye symbol alone.
4. Crimson-lit bow with two blood-red life ribbons flowing from a distant struck target back toward the archer, ghosted backward escape step; lifesteal, extended range, reactive back leap.
ROW 2 dark armored paladin, violet/black steel:
1. Heavy armored boot slamming stone, circular purple ground shockwave hurling nearby silhouettes outward.
2. Black armored swordsman airborne descending sword-first onto one hurt enemy, powerful white-violet strike and arcing leap trail. Not a generic sword icon.
3. Large black steel sword receiving jagged PURPLE LIGHTNING from above, purple curse glow at blade; lightning weapon enchant that reveals attacked enemies.
4. Dark armored chest and roaring helmet engulfed in violet aura, incoming bright blow partly absorbed and a second violet energy bolt redirected toward a different enemy. Defensive damage sharing, not healing.
ROW 3 obese butcher, corroded metal, toxic green/pink:
1. FOUR-POINT SPINNING STEEL SHURIKEN attached to a thick iron CHAIN stretching back, hooked enemy pulled toward viewer, no conventional fishhook.
2. Swirling dense toxic yellow-green gas billowing from massive fleshy belly; sickly silhouetted enemies nearby, no poison bottle.
3. Close-up massive thick pink-grey belly folds with a steel projectile stopped at skin, thick fleshy protection, non-graphic, no armor plate.
4. Huge monstrous open toothy mouth biting an enemy silhouette with a red life ribbon returning into mouth; channelled bite lifesteal. Non-graphic.
ROW 4 fire caster, orange/charcoal:
1. Long flaming JAVELIN flying diagonally, fiery tether dragging two small enemy silhouettes behind along its path. Spear, not sword.
2. One raised hand igniting orange spirit flames around a dark enemy silhouette, bright delayed explosion core around target.
3. A cluster of FIVE distinct flame spirits swirling then rushing toward a single distant impact point, warm orange-white light.
4. Large burning WAR HAMMER flying toward a small enemy, impact ground ring ablaze and prolonged burning tongues; hammer not sword.
No text anywhere. Exact 16 equal square cells.
